notes.title: Patch 1.0.1!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34841047/913996ad7e5da6133348111aee4000484f5ac01a.gif

 Added visual effects to level 5 door
 Adjusted visual effects for balloons
 Fixed particles in multiple places to be more performant
 Adjusted the birds to not be huge in level 2!
 Stopped message in a bottle from pushing you into the ground
 Stopped the cork from making you fly
 Fixed menu not working in levels 4 and 5
 Arrow should now stick in more things
